question: Does the source-calibrated latent sharing state actually release a risk archive when f/g records match the local archive but eta records come from its fixed partner?
design: For each of the256 scored seed/group/held-task profiles B, retain its eta prefix evidence and future density at B's original observed input bank. Replace f/g prefix evidence by that of the fixed partner A at A's own original observed input bank. The local prior is A, learned from its other7 tasks. Population excludes the entire A/B seed pair in both groups. No new responses, noise draws or Gaussian fits.
calibration: Use each held pair's frozen A31 source q distribution. No stress result enters calibration or covariance learning. Uniform reference U, hard sharing J, independent risk A and full-risk CG are fixed diagnostic comparisons; do not choose a winner.
analysis: Report C-I, C-J, C-A, U-I, U-A, C-CG, early/late C-I, shared-state posterior and Bayes-factor distribution after8/23 past observations, separately in both source groups, eight pair-block bootstrap. Quantify how much independent-risk benefit is recovered descriptively only when both comparison means are positive. Compare C-minus-A posterior confidence with reference U; no target cases or deployment-frequency estimation.
controls: The eta-only A and local I scores must reproduce A30 original co-shift scores exactly because only f/g records changed. Forecast identities and all256 held source profiles remain fixed. Shared-state weights use past evidence only, current eta labels only reach scoring. Source q was issued with proper held-pair exclusion.
decision: If source q retains confident sharing despite predictive loss versus the independent model, source conditional-sharing information is inadequate for these recombined heads. Retain the failure; next acquire valid co-observed heterogeneous meta-training records or partition existing paid target histories into explicit meta-training and held evaluation blocks, before any calibration. No automatic target/recommendation test.
limitations: Recombined f/g and eta are from distinct tasks, inputs and original noise distributions. They are not jointly observed simulator batches and need not satisfy the physical linkage between constraint noise and eta. This is a diagnostic of the functional-prior model only; it cannot demonstrate actual risk-only-target benefit or identify its deployment frequency.
